column1: # SPEC-SPELL-120-308 WP-07 (user answer Q4 - DECISIONS D308-13): enemy modifiers. TEST starting values - not measured.
# Each row replaces its reserved row of Rules308_Base and inherits power / speed / shape from the glyph without a final.
# Enemy defence is enemy data (EnemyVitalsProfileSO - 0..1 share of incoming damage removed - default 0).
# brand.scale = damage taken multiplier / break.defence = defence points removed / pierce.defence = share of the defence the hit ignores
# dull.scale = multiplier of the enemy's next strike (once) / weaken.scale = multiplier of every strike / durations in seconds
